svg.aria-label: 目标联系，不表示充分精化
svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Increase the number of profile connections. → Show other people that the stakeholder is ac
tive on LinkedIn.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Obtain referrals from current employees for target-company internships or full-time jobs.
→ Increase the chance that recruiters see the resume.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Find people matching both the target company and the stakeholder's university background.
→ Obtain referrals from current employees for target-company internships or full-time jobs

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Review potential contacts' profiles to judge whether their experience fits the need. → Sen
d connection invitations to suitable potential referrers.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Send connection invitations to suitable potential referrers. → Discuss referral details af
ter the invitation is accepted.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Attach a self-introduction and, when appropriate, a referral request to a connection invit
ation. → Obtain referrals from current employees for target-company internships or full-ti
me jobs.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Choose current target-company employees who attended the same university for referral outr
each. → Find people matching both the target company and the stakeholder's university back
ground.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Increase potential referrers' willingness to help by emphasizing the shared university bac
kground. → Obtain referrals from current employees for target-company internships or full-
time jobs.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Modify search keywords to seek more precise potential-connection results when needed. → Ob
tain more precise people-search results matching the intended background.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Access as many relevant potential connections as needed, using Premium when worthwhile des
pite its cost. → Obtain referrals from current employees for target-company internships or
full-time jobs.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Convey the intended connection message without excessive effort shrinking it to the nonmem
ber character limit. → Attach a self-introduction and, when appropriate, a referral reques
t to a connection invitation.
